memory.description: Persistent user memory with version history.

learning.description: Can learn supported Python skills through self-editing.

conversation.description: Can hold conversations and answer questions through the Groq model.

self_editing.description: Can modify Python code through the supported self-editor flow, but does not independently modify arbitrary code.

tools.description: No general-purpose external tool system is implemented.

internet.description: No general web browsing capability is implemented.

github.description: Can execute configured Git commands such as commit and push.

automation.description: No scheduling or background automation system is implemented.
